default.notes: A visa from a Turkish embassy or consulate is generally required; some travellers holding valid Schengen, US, UK or Irish visas may qualify for the conditional eVisa — check eligibility on evisa.gov.tr before applying.

groups.notes: Visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
Visa-free for short tourist stays of up to 30 days — confirm the current limit on evisa.gov.tr before travel.
Eligible for the official Turkish eVisa (single entry, 30-day stay) at evisa.gov.tr — verify the conditions shown on the portal before travel.

Qualifies for the conditional eVisa (single entry, 30 days) only with a valid visa or residence permit from a Schengen country, the US, the UK or Ireland; otherwise a visa from a Turkish embassy is required. Confirm eligibility on evisa.gov.tr.

RU.notes: Visa-free under the bilateral agreement, commonly reported as up to 60 days per visit and 90 days total in any 180-day period — confirm the current limit before a long stay.

AU.notes: Australian citizens can apply for the official eVisa (multiple entry, 90 days in 180) at evisa.gov.tr. Turkey has recently dropped visa requirements for several Western countries, so check your nationality on the portal before applying.

CY.notes: Turkey does not recognise the Republic of Cyprus; Cypriot passport holders need a visa issued through a Turkish diplomatic mission, typically on a separate document.

TJ.notes: Turkey suspended its visa exemption for Tajik citizens in 2024 — a visa is now required; confirm the current rules with a Turkish embassy before travel.
